tests.name: Pinned production source and completed backup
tests.command: canonical kubectl metadata-only inspection of sure/sure-postgresql and its CNPG Backup
tests.reason: The production source remained healthy and the completed backup retained backupId 20261019T153211; no production object was modified.

tests.name: Synthetic source recovery
tests.reason: sure-rpo-source reached Cluster in healthy state from the pinned production backup in a temporary namespace.

tests.name: Transactional marker with timestamp, LSN and transaction ID

evidence.reference: marker output captured from temporary source

tests.name: Named restore point and WAL archive
tests.command: pg_create_restore_point plus pg_stat_archiver and Barman sidecar logs
tests.reason: Restore point rpo-qual-20261022-1556 returned LSN 0/40041958 and WAL 000000020000000000000040 was archived to the unique qualification prefix.

tests.name: Native CNPG/Barman qualification backup
tests.command: CNPG Backup sure-rpo-source-base-20261022 using plugin barman-cloud.cloudnative-pg.io
tests.reason: Backup completed with backupId 20261022T155631, beginLSN 0/42000028 and endLSN 0/42000120.

tests.name: Target recovery to the named point
tests.command: temporary CNPG Cluster recoveryTarget.backupID=20261022T155631 and targetName=rpo-qual-20261022-1556
tests.reason: sure-rpo-target reached healthy Ready state after recovery from the unique source prefix and named restore point.

tests.name: Isolated application client reads restored marker
tests.command: temporary PostgreSQL client Job using sure-rpo-target-app Secret by reference
tests.reason: The client connected to sure-rpo-target-rw and returned sure, in-recovery=false, one pre-point marker and zero post-point markers without printing credentials.

tests.name: Post-point marker is excluded
tests.reason: The marker committed after the named restore point was absent on the target while the pre-point marker was present; no committed marker was lost at the tested boundary.

tests.name: Cross-namespace and public egress rejection
tests.command: bounded TCP probes from source and target CNPG pods
tests.reason: Source-to-target, target-to-source and target-to-public probes all exited 124 under the temporary Cilium policies.

tests.name: Production source preservation
tests.command: canonical metadata-only recheck of production Sure cluster and source Backup
tests.reason: Production source UID, Ready state, primary and source backup metadata were unchanged after the synthetic run.

tests.name: Exact unique S3 prefix cleanup
tests.command: Barman list, backup-delete --dry-run, backup-delete and final list using the temporary prefix
tests.reason: The unique prefix was listed, dry-run enumerated only the synthetic backup and WAL objects, native delete removed backupId 20261022T155631, and final list returned no backup rows.

tests.name: Exact temporary Kubernetes and Longhorn cleanup
tests.command: delete temporary namespaces, verify UIDs, then delete four PVs and four Longhorn volumes
tests.reason: Both temporary namespaces, their dependent resources, four exact PVs and four exact Longhorn volumes were removed; historical recovery resources were not selected.

tests.name: Authoritative Jellyfin credential availability
tests.command: Doppler names-only inspection plus live ExternalSecret status
tests.reason: APP_JELLYSEERR_JELLYFIN_API_KEY is absent from cluster/prd and no alternate authority was found; operator generation through Jellyfin was unavailable.

tests.name: OpenClaw decommission owner and desired source
tests.command: Git search plus Argo, Helm and live metadata inventory
tests.reason: No active consumer exists, but the live Ready operator has no current Argo Application or desired manifest owner; direct deletion would violate the Git desired-state boundary.

tests.name: Attribution and deletion of 21 historical residues
tests.reason: All 21 residues remain REVIEW; owner and disposable status are not proven for safe deletion, and PLT-105 must remain intact.

tests.name: Repository deterministic checks
tests.command: just check and npm run check:agent-harness
tests.reason: Repository contract suite, agent harness contract, Paperclip retirement contract, Argo root contract, inventory graph and resource-efficiency checks passed locally.

evidence.reference: local just check and npm run check:agent-harness output
